title: Thai-Style Stir-Fried Ujuicy with Croation
description: A quick and flavorful Thai dish made with stir-fried ujuicy and croation, served with a tangy mustard sauce.
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the ujuicy and croation to the skillet and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add the mustard to the skillet and stir-fry for another minute.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
